title: Guarded motor with retained run command
requirements:
# SELF001: Guarded Motor Latch

## Background
Teaching controller for a guarded single-motor latch (not a safety-rated circuit).

## Functional Requirements
1. Inputs: `Start`, `Stop`, and `GuardClosed` (`BOOL`, all level-sensitive).
2. On every scan, if `Stop = TRUE` or `GuardClosed = FALSE`, force `Run := FALSE`.
3. Otherwise, if `Start = TRUE`, set `Run := TRUE` (including when `Start` stays TRUE on the scan `GuardClosed` closes).
4. Otherwise retain the previous `Run` state.

## Interface
- **Inputs:** `Start: BOOL`, `Stop: BOOL`, `GuardClosed: BOOL`
- **Outputs:** `Run: BOOL`

## Initial Values
- `Run=false`

## Timing & Evaluation Conventions
Signals are sampled every scan (`dt_ms` is unused for logical transitions).
scenario: A packaging motor uses a door guard as a scan-level permissive and a retained operator run request.
scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: Open guard and Stop override Start
Loss of permissive clears the retained latch
assumptions: Inputs are level-sensitive; no start edge is required.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

atomic_propositions.Run: O[k].Run: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.first: k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation
atomic_propositions.qRun: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].Run", "initial": false, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Run; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Run=false.

ltl.description: Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.
ltl.explanation: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
The instance starts with no retained run request.
Stop and guard override every startup request in the same scan.
A permitted start takes effect at end of the sampled scan.
Retain the preceding run value without a new command.
Across invocations, run persists unless a higher-priority input intervenes.
